current_prompt.body:
READ the list L = {71, 97, 54, 56, 44, 158, 45, 58, 82, 135, 113, 117, 86, 40, 12, 185, 63, 50, 111, 72, 90, 109, 61, 13, 92, 60, 91, 35, 114, 94, 105, 26, 15, 51, 102, 118, 76, 32, 108, 23, 22, 134, 83, 43, 64}
DETERMINE IF L can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each triple
IF a valid partition exists THEN
    RETURN one complete example of such a partition
ELSE
    RETURN a statement that no valid partition exists
ENDIF

current_plan.body:
READ the list L
GENERATE all triples (a, b, c) from L satisfying a + b = c
SELECT a collection of 15 disjoint triples that together include every element of L
IF such a collection exists THEN
    RETURN one complete example of the collection
ELSE
    RETURN a statement that no valid collection exists
ENDIF
